name: meowave
description: Tooling for the Meowave desktop player: badge catalog, Supabase schema and seeding.

scripts.android:build: bash -c 'source scripts/setup-android-env.sh && tauri android build --apk && if [ -f src-tauri/gen/android/app/build/outputs/apk/universal/release/app-universal-release-unsigned.apk ]; then apksigner sign --ks src-tauri/gen/android/keystore.jks --ks-pass pass:meowave123 --key-pass pass:meowave123 --out src-tauri/gen/android/app/build/outputs/apk/universal/release/app-universal-release-signed.apk src-tauri/gen/android/app/build/outputs/apk/universal/release/app-universal-release-unsigned.apk; fi'
scripts.android:build:x86: bash -c 'source scripts/setup-android-env.sh && tauri android build --apk --target x86_64 --debug'
scripts.check: cd src-tauri && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test
